quickCapturePlaceholder: Type it before you forget it…
quickCaptureNeedInbox: Choose an inbox page in Quick Capture settings first.
capturePresetsDesc: Reusable buttons for the capture dialog. Each preset stores its own destination, content format, tags, and timestamp settings.
presetEditorHint: Create a one-click button for the capture dialog. The button applies these settings, then you write the capture.
presetNameHint: Shown on the button in Quick Capture.
presetNotebookHint: Used for daily notes or timestamp cards.
presetEntityHint: Choose where this preset should capture into.
presetInboxNote: The unsorted inbox needs no extra destination settings.
presetTagsHint: Comma-separated tags added to every capture from this preset.
presetTaskHint: Turn each line into a checkbox task.
presetContentHint: Task list turns each line into a checkbox. Use a Page destination for a todo block.
presetTimestampHint: Prefixes each task with the current date and time.
presetTimestampFormatHint: Used by {datetime} and task timestamps. Tokens: YYYY, YY, MM, DD, HH, mm, ss.
presetTemplateHint: Use {text}, {title}, {date}, {time}, {datetime}, {tags}, or {source}. Tags are added automatically unless you use {tags}.
quickCapturePresetTaskFormat: Each line becomes a task with timestamp ({format}).
quickCapturePresetTask: Each line becomes a task block.
quickCaptureNeedDailyNb: Pick a daily-note notebook first (Settings → Fussy_Fran).
quickCaptureNeedZettelNb: Pick a cards notebook first (Settings → Fussy_Fran).
quickCaptureNoDaily: Today's daily note not found — create it first.
setQuickSectionDesc: Persistent inbox, favorite destinations, daily notes, and timestamp cards.
setInboxDocumentDesc: Choose the SiYuan document used to persist unsorted captures.
setFavoriteDatabasesDesc: Select attribute views offered as capture targets.
setFavoritePagesDesc: Select pages offered as capture destinations.
setCaptureHotkeyDesc: The shortcut takes effect after restarting the plugin.
setZettelPathDesc: Subpath in the cards notebook, e.g. /Cards
setZettelPathPrompt: No cards directory set — pick a notebook and path to create one:
setZettelPathCreated: Cards directory set to {path} in notebook {name}
setDefaultTargetDesc: Which destination is selected when Quick Capture opens.
setDbSectionDesc: Compact read-only mirror of database attrs on blocks.
setNbIdsDesc: Set via capture dialog dropdowns; IDs persist automatically.
setExposeRefreshDesc: Show a refresh button next to the back arrow in the toolbar.
triageNeedInbox: Choose an inbox page in Quick Capture settings.
triageNoTargets: Configure a page or database target first
